title: Run community survey on save behavior (G1)
source_finding: Office-hours Assignment + CEO plan pre-build gate: survey r/ADHD, r/Instagram, r/datacurator, r/productivity on save behavior

title: Run 20-reel ingest spike and codify as eval suite (G2)
source_finding: 3E decision: the 20-reel spike becomes a permanent regression eval (fixture pages + expected cards), run on every extraction change. Failure branch pre-committed: <80% extraction on educational/tool reels -> user-provided caption path

title: Add SSRF host-allowlist to ingest Edge Function
source_finding: 3C decision (Section 3): ingest function fetches URLs server-side; validate host == instagram.com / *.instagram.com before fetching. Reject everything else with error

title: Harden Claude extraction: structured output + schema validation + retry
source_finding: 3B decision (Section 2): Claude can return malformed JSON / empty / refusal. Use structured output with schema validation + 1 retry. Bare-save fallback on persistent failure

title: Harden queue scheduler: idempotency + stale-PENDING cleanup + health check + kill switch
source_finding: 3B + 3D decisions (Sections 2, 8): cron idempotency (job_id dedup), daily cleanup of stale PENDING saves to bare saves, daily cron health check alert, push kill-switch flag. Unit-test FIFO + rerank ordering with fixed timestamps

title: Add observability: Sentry iOS + structured Edge Function logs
source_finding: 3D decision (Section 8): Sentry on iOS, structured logs in Edge Functions (user_id, post_id, failure stage). The product is one push/day - silently dead cron = dead product

title: Build async instant card in share extension (D2.1)
source_finding: 3A decision (Section 1): iOS share extensions are memory/time-capped; card renders ASYNC (Saving... -> card). Bare-save fallback inline in extension. App Group auth

title: Build today's-card widget (D2.4)
source_finding: D2.4 cherry-pick + CEO plan review: WidgetKit timeline + App Group provisioning + timeline invalidation when server-assigned card changes. Effort M, not S. Shared rendering with in-app card

title: Build context-field rerank (D2.3)
source_finding: D2.3 cherry-pick: 'what are you working on' column + rerank in queue scheduler. Rerank picks which eligible card is today's; 3-day window unchanged. Free tier (paid-tier decision)

title: Build shareable card image export (D2.5)
source_finding: D2.5 cherry-pick: server-generated card image keyed by card ID. Text-only fallback on image-gen failure. Free tier (paid-tier decision)

title: Add index on (user_id, instagram_post_id)
source_finding: Section 7: dedupe lookup needs the index at MVP scale-trivial load

title: Run concierge desirability test: hand-write cards for 10-20 users' saved reels
source_finding: Outside voice tension #1 (ACCEPTED): answers 'does anyone want a delayed AI card' with zero platform engineering. Recruit from survey pool. Test delay preference (2/3/5/7 days). Kill signal: no engagement on manual cards -> stop before extraction pipeline

title: Add server-side fetch gate to ingest spike (datacenter IP)
source_finding: Outside voice tension #2 (ACCEPTED): verify caption fetch from Supabase datacenter IP - login walls, consent interstitials, bot-blocking. Failure branch: user-provided caption path

title: Refactor free/paid boundary to meter pushes, not saves
source_finding: Outside voice tension #3 (ACCEPTED): scarce unit is attention. Free = 1 push/day within monthly push budget; paid = more pushes. Keep 50-save cap as implementation detail. A/B both meters at Week 6

title: First card arrives day 1 after first save
source_finding: Outside voice tension #4 (ACCEPTED): 3 days of activation silence is a retention killer. First card day 1, then 3-day cadence. Delay preference validated in concierge test

title: Anonymous auth from share extension + account merge
source_finding: Outside voice point 4 (implementation note): extension needs JWT without app-open. Anonymous auth + merge on app open. Deferred while concierge runs
